name: Azar Chicken
description: Home of broasted, gaz, and charcoal-grilled chicken, sandwiches, shawarma, and tawook — made fresh, served fast.

about.story: Since 1999, Azar Chicken has been serving the neighborhood signature broasted and crispy chicken made with a family recipe passed down for generations. What started as a small kitchen has grown into a local favorite for chicken and burger lovers. TEST
